description: This Java class 'PemReader' provides functionality to read and parse PEM (Privacy-Enhanced Mail) files, extracting their entries which include the type and payload data. It offers methods for reading PEM files synchronously, asynchronously with Vertx, or from provided readers or buffers.

classes.name: PemReader
classes.description: Final utility class for reading PEM files, providing both synchronous and asynchronous methods.

classes.name: PemReader.Entry
classes.description: Inner static class representing a single PEM file entry with its type and payload.

methods.name: readAll
methods.description: Reads a PEM file from a given Path and returns the list of entries synchronously.

methods.name: readAllBlocking
methods.description: Reads a PEM file asynchronously in a blocking manner using Vertx and returns the list of entries.

methods.name: readAllFromBuffer
methods.description: Parses a Buffer object containing PEM data and returns the list of entries.

methods.name: readAll
methods.description: Asynchronously reads a PEM file using Vertx and passes the result or error to the given handler.

methods.name: readAll
methods.description: Reads and parses PEM entries from a provided Reader.
